ABOUT LINKS INC.

Shaping minds and the future through academic excellence.

LINKS Inc. (League of Innovative National Knowledge Seekers) provides national academic opportunities that encourage learners to think deeply, communicate confidently, explore ideas, and pursue excellence.

The organization conducts ten national tournaments spanning mathematics, science, language, social studies, scholastic ability, MAPEH, Filipino, Bible knowledge, values education, and computer science and technology.

THE OFFICIAL MASCOT

Meet LINX, the Knowledge Spark.

LINX is the official mascot concept of LINKS Inc. It represents curiosity, academic excellence, innovation, and the passion of young knowledge seekers to explore, discover, and excel in every field of learning.

What LINX stands for

LINX stands for energy, ideas, and inspiration. As the Knowledge Spark, LINX symbolizes the beginning of learning, the excitement of competition, and the bright future that comes from knowledge, teamwork, and creativity.

In the LINKS Inc. website, LINX serves as a friendly visual ambassador for the organization and its national academic tournaments.

OFFICIAL TOURNAMENT GUIDELINES

National Mathematics Tournament (NMT) — Mental Math

Overview

A nationwide academic competition designed to promote excellence in Mathematics among Filipino learners from Kinder 1 to Grade 12 in public and private schools. It challenges problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and mathematical creativity.

Objectives

  • Deepen understanding of mathematical concepts beyond the curriculum.
  • Sharpen problem-solving skills—critical, logical, and creative—under pressure.
  • Improve student performance and boost self-esteem.
  • Prepare learners for advanced study.
  • Connect students with like-minded peers, mentors, and academic communities.

Equipment / IT Requirements

  • One device only with stable high-speed internet.
  • Laptop with functional camera and audio; desktop with digital camera and audio; or mobile phone compatible with Autoproctor.

Test Format

30-item multiple-choice examination; 60 minutes; 1 point per correct answer. The exam link is sent by email and is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Autoproctor is used. Calculators are not allowed; scratch paper may be used.

Participant Categories

Kindergarten 1 & 2; Grades 1–10; Grades 11 & 12.

Topics Covered

  • Algebra
  • Statistics and Probability
  • Geometry
  • Logical Thinking
  • Number Theory

Awards

Score RangeAwardRecognition
25–30Gold MedalMedal and certificate
16–24Silver MedalMedal and certificate
8–15Bronze MedalMedal and certificate
4–7MeritCertificate
0–3ParticipationE-Certificate

The guidelines also provide recognition for winning coaches and top-performing schools. Results and recognitions may be posted on the official LINKS Facebook page; several tournaments also use a points system for outstanding coaches.

OFFICIAL TOURNAMENT GUIDELINES

National Science Tournament (NSciT)

Overview

A nationwide academic competition that fosters scientific curiosity, critical thinking, and research-oriented learning among Filipino students from Kinder 1 to Grade 12.

Objectives

  • Promote deeper understanding of science concepts beyond the classroom.
  • Encourage logical reasoning, experimentation, and creative solutions.
  • Provide opportunities for awards, scholarships, and future academic prospects.
  • Connect students with peers, educators, and professionals nationwide.
  • Highlight schools’ commitment to science education.
  • Encourage young minds to pursue research, technology, and scientific careers.

Equipment / IT Requirements

  • One device only with stable high-speed internet.
  • Laptop with functional camera and audio; desktop with digital camera and audio; or mobile phone compatible with Autoproctor.

Test Format

30-item multiple-choice examination; 90 minutes; 1 point per correct answer. The exam link is sent by email and is open on the exam date. Autoproctor is used.

Participant Categories

Kindergarten 1 & 2; Grades 1–10; Grades 11 & 12.

Topics Covered

  • Biology — cell structure/function, genetics, ecosystems, human anatomy and physiology, biodiversity.
  • Chemistry — atomic structure, bonding, states of matter, reactions, periodic table, solutions.
  • Physics — motion and forces, energy transformation, waves and sound, electricity and magnetism, simple machines.
  • Environmental Science — ecosystems, conservation, climate change, pollution, sustainable development.
  • Astronomy — celestial bodies, solar system, stars and galaxies, space exploration, cosmology.

Awards

Score RangeAwardRecognition
25–30Gold MedalMedal and certificate
16–24Silver MedalMedal and certificate
8–15Bronze MedalMedal and certificate
4–7MeritCertificate
0–3ParticipationCertificate

The guidelines also provide recognition for winning coaches and top-performing schools. Results and recognitions may be posted on the official LINKS Facebook page; several tournaments also use a points system for outstanding coaches.

OFFICIAL TOURNAMENT GUIDELINES

National English Tournament (NET)

Overview

An online academic competition for bona fide students from Kinder 1 to Grade 12 enrolled in Philippine schools, designed to strengthen English language competencies in grammar, vocabulary, reading comprehension, and writing.

Objectives

  • Improve grammar, vocabulary, reading comprehension, and writing.
  • Develop written and verbal communication skills.
  • Elevate critical thinking skills.
  • Boost self-confidence in speaking, writing, and performance.
  • Enhance creativity and build discipline.

Equipment / IT Requirements

  • One device only with stable high-speed internet.
  • Laptop with camera and audio; desktop with digital camera and audio; or mobile phone compatible with Autoproctor.

Test Format

30-item multiple-choice examination; 90 minutes; 1 point per correct answer. The exam link is sent by email and is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Autoproctor is used. Calculators are not allowed.

Participant Categories

Kindergarten 1 & 2; Grades 1–10; Grades 11 & 12.

Topics Covered

  • Grammar — subject-verb agreement, verb tenses, prepositions/conjunctions, punctuation, sentence structure, pronouns, parallelism, direct/reported speech, figures of speech.
  • Vocabulary — synonyms/antonyms, context clues, idioms, word choice/nuance, multiple-meaning words, collocations, academic/high-frequency vocabulary.
  • Reading Comprehension — main ideas/details, inference, summarizing, tone/mood, critical analysis.
  • Writing — logical organization, grammar/vocabulary, purposes/audiences, spelling and punctuation.
  • Spelling — high-frequency words, phonetic patterns, prefixes/suffixes/root words, irregular words, spelling rules and strategies.

Awards

Score RangeAwardRecognition
25–30Gold MedalMedal and certificate

8–15Bronze MedalMedal and certificate

National Social Studies Tournament (NSST)

Overview

A nationwide online academic competition covering Philippine, Asian and World history, current events, geography, government, economics, culture, and society for Kindergarten to Grade 12 learners.

Objectives

  • Deepen understanding of history, current events, geography, government, economics, culture, and society.
  • Foster appreciation of Philippine historical heritage and cultural diversity.
  • Enhance critical thinking, analytical reasoning, research skills, and interpretation of historical/social information.
  • Strengthen Social Studies learning through meaningful academic competition.
  • Inspire responsible citizenship and respect for cultural diversity and civic values.
  • Promote informed understanding of social issues and active community participation.

Equipment / IT Requirements

  • One device only with stable high-speed internet.
  • Laptop with functional camera and audio or desktop with digital camera and audio.

Test Format

30-item multiple-choice examination; 90 minutes. The exam link is open from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM; participants may choose a convenient 90-minute period.

Participant Categories

Kindergarten 1 & 2; Grades 1–10; Grades 11 & 12.

Topics Covered

  • Philippine, Asian and World History
  • Geography and Environment
  • Government and Citizenship
  • Economics and Livelihood
  • Culture and Philippine Society
  • Social and Global Issues
  • Heritage and National Identity

Awards

National Scholastic Ability Tournament (NSAT)

Overview

A nationwide academic competition designed to assess and develop intellectual abilities, academic readiness, critical thinking, and problem-solving among Kinder 1 to Grade 12 learners.

Objectives

  • Develop critical thinking, logical reasoning, and problem-solving.
  • Assess and strengthen scholastic aptitude across academic and intellectual areas.
  • Enhance reading comprehension, analytical reasoning, numerical ability, and verbal skills.
  • Encourage application of knowledge to complex and unfamiliar problems.
  • Promote academic excellence, confidence, perseverance, and independent thinking.
  • Inspire learners to develop intellectual potential and lifelong enthusiasm for learning.

Equipment / IT Requirements

  • One device only with stable high-speed internet.
  • Laptop with functional camera and audio or desktop with digital camera and audio.

Test Format

30-item multiple-choice examination; 90 minutes. The exam link is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM; participants may take the exam at a convenient time for 90 minutes.

Participant Categories

Kindergarten 1 & 2; Grades 1–10; Grades 11 & 12.

Topics Covered

  • Verbal Ability
  • Reading Comprehension
  • Numerical Ability
  • Logical and Abstract Reasoning
  • Analytical Reasoning
  • Spatial and Visual Reasoning

National MAPEH Tournament (NMAT)

Overview

A nationwide academic competition designed to enhance knowledge, skills, creativity, and appreciation in Music, Arts, Physical Education, and Health among Kinder 1 to Grade 12 learners.

Objectives

  • Deepen understanding and appreciation of Music, Arts, Physical Education, and Health.
  • Develop musical awareness, artistic creativity, physical fitness, and health literacy.
  • Enhance critical thinking, creativity, coordination, performance skills, and decision-making.
  • Strengthen MAPEH teaching and learning through active engagement and application.
  • Promote creativity, self-expression, teamwork, discipline, wellness, and cultural appreciation.
  • Inspire healthy lifestyles, physical activity, artistic expression, and cultural appreciation.

Equipment / IT Requirements

  • One device only with stable high-speed internet.
  • Laptop with functional camera and audio or desktop with digital camera and audio.

Test Format

30-item multiple-choice examination; 90 minutes. The exam link is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM; participants may take the exam at a convenient time for 90 minutes.

Participant Categories

Kindergarten 1 & 2; Grades 1–10; Grades 11 & 12.

Topics Covered

  • Music — theory, elements/principles, instruments, genres, composers, performers, Philippine/world music.
  • Arts — elements/principles, visual arts, techniques, artists, artworks, Philippine/contemporary art.
  • Physical Education — fitness, movement, sports, games, dance, exercise principles, active lifestyles.
  • Health — nutrition, mental/emotional well-being, safety, disease prevention, first aid, healthy habits, community health.
  • Philippine Culture and Heritage — traditional music, dances, visual arts, indigenous expressions, preservation.
  • Contemporary MAPEH — current trends in music, arts, fitness, health, digital media, and creative expression.

Awards

National Filipino Tournament (NFT)

Overview

A nationwide academic competition designed to promote mastery of the Filipino language, literature, culture, and national identity among Kinder 1 to Grade 12 learners.

Objectives

  • Deepen understanding of Filipino grammar, vocabulary, and rhetoric.
  • Foster appreciation and critical analysis of classical and contemporary Philippine literature.
  • Enhance reading comprehension, analytical skills, and linguistic competence.
  • Strengthen Filipino language programs and instructional practices.
  • Inspire pride in national identity, heritage, and socio-cultural values.
  • Promote Filipino as a tool for nation-building and unity.

Equipment / IT Requirements

  • One device only with stable high-speed internet.
  • Laptop with functional camera and audio or desktop with digital camera and audio.

Test Format

30-item multiple-choice examination; 90 minutes. The exam link is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM; participants may take the exam anytime during the day for 90 minutes.

Participant Categories

Kindergarten 1 & 2; Grades 1–10; Grades 11 & 12.

Topics Covered

  • Wika at Balarila (Grammar and Language Mechanics)
  • Bokabularyo at Retorika (Vocabulary and Rhetoric)
  • Panitikang Pilipino (Classical and Contemporary Philippine Literature)
  • Pag-unawa sa Pagbasa (Reading Comprehension and Critical Analysis)
  • Kultura, Tradisyon, at Kasaysayan ng Wika
  • Filipino sa Makabagong Panahon (Research, Media, and Contemporary Society)

Awards

National Bible Knowledge Tournament (NBKT)

Overview

A nationwide online academic tournament that fosters biblical knowledge, spiritual understanding, critical thinking, and appreciation of teachings and principles in the Holy Bible among Kinder 1 to Grade 12 learners.

Objectives

  • Promote deeper understanding and appreciation of the Bible and its teachings beyond the classroom.
  • Encourage critical thinking, reflection, and meaningful engagement with biblical principles.
  • Provide recognition, awards, and academic enrichment through Bible knowledge competitions.
  • Connect students with learners, educators, and schools across the Philippines.
  • Highlight commitment to values formation, character development, and biblical education.
  • Inspire learners to apply biblical teachings and values in daily life and communities.

Equipment / IT Requirements

  • One device only with stable high-speed internet.
  • Laptop with functional camera and audio; desktop with digital camera and audio; or mobile phone compatible with Autoproctor.

Test Format

30-item multiple-choice examination; 90 minutes; 5 choices per item.

Participant Categories

Kindergarten 1 & 2; Grades 1–10; Grades 11 & 12.

Topics Covered

  • Biblical People and Characters
  • Biblical Events and History
  • Biblical Teachings and Values
  • Biblical Places, Objects, and Terminology
  • Key Verses and Biblical References

National Values Education Tournament (NVET)

Overview

An online academic competition for bona fide Kinder to Grade 12 students in Philippine schools, designed to strengthen the understanding and application of values, ethical principles, character formation, and responsible citizenship.

Objectives

  • Strengthen understanding of values and ethical principles and their importance in daily life.
  • Develop moral reasoning and responsible decision-making.
  • Enhance critical and reflective thinking in real-life situations and ethical concerns.
  • Promote integrity, respect, empathy, responsibility, compassion, and self-discipline.
  • Foster self-confidence and social awareness.
  • Cultivate responsible citizenship and positive relationships at home, school, and community.

Equipment / IT Requirements

  • One device only with stable high-speed internet.
  • Laptop with functional camera and audio or desktop with digital camera and audio.

Test Format

30-item multiple-choice examination; 90 minutes; 1 point per correct answer. The exam link is sent by email and is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Autoproctor is used.

Participant Categories

Kindergarten 1 & 2; Grades 1–10; Grades 11 & 12.

Topics Covered

  • Faith and Spiritual Values
  • Respect and Human Dignity
  • Environmental Responsibility
  • Love of Country and Citizenship
  • Character Formation and Personal Responsibility
  • Ethical Reasoning and Decision-Making
  • Social Responsibility and Responsible Citizenship

Awards
